name: error-3
title: 500 Server Error With Retry
description: 500 server error page with an alert icon, Try Again and Contact Support actions, and a monospace reference code to quote to support.

standards.purpose: Explain what went wrong and give the fastest route back.
useWhen: A request failed, access was denied, or the route does not exist.
doNotUseWhen: A recoverable inline error can be shown next to the control that caused it.

rules.check: The page is served with the real HTTP status (404, 403, 500), not 200.
Every error page offers at least one working way forward.
Copy explains the situation without blaming the visitor or leaking internals.
A retry action is offered only when retrying can succeed.
